title: DailySpend
details: Developed a native iOS expense tracker using SwiftUI, SwiftData, and CloudKit, with local-first storage, background sync, and split-bill support, serving 10+ active users.
Implemented schema migrations across model versions and interactive spending analytics with custom SwiftUI charts and animations, maintaining a responsive UI.
Built bill-splitting flows for equal and itemized splits, including shared items, tax, tips, and cent-accurate allocation.
Added receipt scanning, monthly and category budgets, recurring expenses, and data export and backup features.

title: E-Commerce Order Management Platform
summary: An orders service built to test, ship, and scale.
details: Built a containerized Flask/PostgreSQL REST API for order management with customer, status, and date queries. Used Flask-RESTX/Swagger and test-first development, maintaining 95%+ test coverage on Codecov.
Automated test, container-build, and deployment workflows with GitHub Actions and Tekton, running Behave BDD and Selenium tests on each merge.

title: MissionFlow – United Airlines Airshop Lab
details: Built a full-stack platform with United Airlines’ Airshop Lab to centralize robotic R&D mission data and automate file transfer, command execution, and post-mission workflows, reducing manual overhead by 75%.
Integrated Boston Dynamics robot controls with real-time mission analytics in a unified interface, reducing operational error rates by 15% and supporting multi-robot workflows.
Improved UI responsiveness and data visualization through modular React components and optimized REST APIs.
summary: One workspace for robotic R&D missions.

title: Ryan's Ice Cream Online Ordering System
details: Designed and implemented an online cake-ordering platform using AppFront and Figma, improving user experience and increasing sales by 35%.
Integrated secure payment processing, inventory tracking, and order management features, reducing manual errors by 20%.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and perform user testing, ensuring intuitive and maintainable UI design.
Delivered a robust backend supporting data-driven insights and future scalability.
summary: A simpler way to order something sweet.

title: NASA Renewable Energy Data Visualization
details: Used NASA’s POWER dataset to analyze solar and wind potential across U.S. counties and assess renewable energy feasibility.
Built an interactive visualization using React with dynamic color-coded maps and filtering tools to compare energy trends.
Developed a high-performance, stateless REST API with Node.js and MongoDB for efficient data retrieval.
Presented research findings at the 2023 ESIP Meeting, demonstrating real-world applications of open energy data.

title: RPI Foodies Dining Hall Ranking Platform
details: Built a community-driven dining ranking site allowing RPI students to share, rate, and discuss campus meals.
Implemented weekly food ranking algorithms based on user engagement and feedback.
Developed admin tools for content moderation, ensuring platform reliability and security.
Built a responsive interface for mobile and desktop users.
summary: Campus dining, rated by the community.
